title: Guitars
description: CIT resource pack that adds cool electric guitars to Minecraft!
body:
Guitars

**To obtain, rename any sword/axe on anvil using a name from the model list. If the model does not appear, check that the name is correct and that the resource pack is enabled.**
All Renames ``` Version 1.1 - (sword/axe) Lobotomy - (sword/axe) Aqua - (sword/axe) Mojito - (sword/axe) Pinky - (sword/axe) Carbon - (sword/axe) Canary - (sword/axe) Neon Riff - (sword/axe) Pearl - (sword/axe) PeepoBad ```
## **If you are playing on a version lower than 1.21.5:** **The pack requires [Optifine](https://optifine.net/home)** **If you're playing on Fabric, this pack requires [Cit Resewn](https://modrinth.com/mod/cit-resewn)** ![renames-list](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/35202f4b0c47bcb23fbc6795856eec8adc97eb47.png) ![first person view](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/u6vG1AZi/images/420c0d9f6ed11ec96bb7f1579aac4b3272c8a371.png) **Author of the original model - [https://x.com/Wan_w1n](https://x.com/Wan_w1n)** # **Social**
